diagnosis: The IdP signing certificate was rotated without updating the metadata configured on the account, so assertion validation fails for all SSO sign-ins. Per kb-0006 the fix is to re-upload the current IdP metadata and validate with a single test account before re-enabling enforcement for all users.
reply:
Thanks for the details, and sorry for the disruption this morning.

This pattern matches a metadata mismatch after an identity provider certificate rotation: when the signing certificate changes without the identity provider metadata being re-uploaded, sign-in attempts fail with an assertion error for everyone.

What to do:
1. Export the current metadata (or metadata URL) from your identity provider so it includes the new signing certificate.
2. Re-upload that metadata in your SSO configuration.
3. Re-test sign-in with a single account first, and confirm it succeeds before re-enabling enforcement for the rest of your users.

If sign-in still fails after re-uploading the metadata, let us know and we will take a closer look at the configuration on our side.
